AI cloud business rollout news; Cramer called it 'instantly profitable'. Meta the biggest support for S&P/Nasdaq on Wed

geo_headlines: NFP June: 57K actual vs 110K cons — big miss. UR fell to 4.2% from 4.3%. AHE +0.3% m/m. April revised down 31K to 148K, May revised down 43K to 129K — combined 74K lower than prior report. Traders saw <20% chance of July hike after print

Wed close (Q3 open): SPX 7,483.23 -0.22%, Nasdaq 26,040.03 -0.66%, Dow 52,305.24 -0.03% (gave up 423-point intraday rally). SOX -6.27% to 13,353.28 — 28 of 30 components down. Q3 opened lower after best Q2 since 2020

Meta cloud-business bombshell: reported plan to sell AI computing power triggered repricing of the entire chip complex; excess AI capacity fears now front-and-center. META rallied on the news even as chips cratered

Kospi -7.89% to 7,648.09 (worst day in months): SK Hynix -14.6%, Samsung -9.1%; circuit breaker triggered at open. First Kospi close below 8,000 since June 11. Kosdaq -6.74%. Kospi -8.9% intraday low before some recovery

Sintra panel Wed: Warsh + Lagarde + Bailey + Macklem — Warsh dodged specific rate-path commitment. US stocks slid on the ambiguity. ADP disappointed at 98K vs 110K cons; ISM Mfg 53.3 vs 53.9 est but prices sub-index cooled

Post-NFP tape reaction: ES -0.7%, NQ -2.28% (Kospi bleed continuing), VIX 16.92 +1.99%, US 10Y 4.485% +0.22bp, US 2Y 4.139% -0.6bp (curve steepening on soft jobs), gold +1.3% to 4,121. BTC 60,081 +0.22%
